posts.title: I measured success wrong three times, and the method I was testing did nothing
posts.summary: Progressive disclosure was supposed to make a browser agent cheaper. Each time I fixed how I measured success, a conclusion reversed — and the method ended up earning nothing. What actually halved the context was a line in my own harness that re-sent the model a page it had already been shown.
